{{jbocre/en}}

"Fishy apples" is a concept from an unofficial article by author [[la gleki]] called "[https://jbotcan.org/lojban/en/tlon-uqbar-la-gleki-fishy-apples/ Tlön, Uqbar and la gleki's fishy apples]".

The article describes the difference between languages that describe reality as objects and languages that describe reality via properties.
